items.title: Somalia and Italy Together for Fisheries and the Blue Economy
items.description: (ANSA) - NAIROBI, 12 AGO - The Italian Ambassador to Somalia, Pier Mario Daccò Coppi, met with the Minister of Fisheries and the Blue Economy, Ahmed Hassan Adan, to receive an update on ongoing programs and exchange views on the prospects for a greater Italian presence in the sector. The Somali minister thanked Italy for funding the cooperation project aimed at strengthening the fisheries supply chain in the city of Bosaso (Puntland), expressing the hope that this initiative could be replicated in other locations across Somalia to contribute to the development of coastal communities. items.titleIt: Somalia and Italy Together for Fisheries and the Blue Economy

items.title: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab
items.description: The Somali government’s battle with Al-Shabaab militants grinds on, with neither able to gain a decisive advantage.
